result.summary: The screen is mostly well-structured, with minor styling inconsistencies across card components.

issues.description: Inconsistent favorite button styling between cards; one has a semi-transparent circular backing while the other floats directly on the image.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon container across all cards for consistent visual hierarchy.

issues.description: Redundant delivery fee information on the popular restaurant card showing both a badge and subtitle text.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate delivery fee mention from either the image badge or the metadata line.
